plot: A full-time crimefighter protects a city that has forgotten who he is, while watching people from his past move on without him. As loneliness and strange changes in his abilities add to the pressure, he must face a dangerous new threat that puts the city and those he cares about at risk.
When a group of former childhood friends reconnect, their reunion takes a wild turn as they stumble upon a dangerous international plot—and must save the world.

A young mother raising her daughter in the house where she grew up discovers she can enter a parallel realm inhabited by dangerous spirits. When she learns she can bring entities from that world into reality, she must confront a growing supernatural threat while protecting her family.

After the son of a mayoral candidate is kidnapped, the candidate and his wife have only a few hours to find the ransom. With most of their money tied up in the campaign, they must take desperate steps that bring hidden parts of their lives into view.

A legendary thief recruits two young strangers to help steal a famous painting, then reveals an unexpected family connection. Thrust into a chaotic reunion, the new family must learn to work together—and tolerate one another—if they hope to pull off an ambitious heist.

After a mysterious cosmic event tears an ordinary suburban neighborhood from its familiar surroundings, a family finds itself in an unknown and increasingly dangerous place. With the landscape transformed and prehistoric dangers nearby, they must stick together and navigate the strange new world in hopes of surviving.

t: Resident Evil: Welcome to Raccoon City
plot: Once a thriving company town, Raccoon City has fallen into decline after a pharmaceutical giant departs. When a hidden evil spreads through the town, a small group of survivors must work together through the night and seek the truth behind the company.
A young reporter and her reluctant cameraman chase a story, only to get entangled in an illegal sand-mining racket run by a ruthless syndicate.

After a chance encounter sparks a sweeping romance, a young woman’s future is suddenly upended. An unexpected journey leads her toward love and learning to live again, as she faces a changed future and discovers what comes next.

A lovesick young man breaks a mysterious wishing object in hopes of winning his crush’s heart. When his wish comes true in an unsettling way, he must face the disturbing consequences of getting exactly what he wanted.

A cybersecurity expert uncovers evidence of alien secrets and becomes a whistleblower, forcing him to evade a powerful corporation. At the same time, a meteorologist experiencing unusual phenomena joins his effort to persuade the world that life may exist beyond human understanding.

After solving a major case, two rookie officers follow a new mystery that unsettles their animal-filled city. Their investigation takes them undercover into unfamiliar neighborhoods, where they must work through fresh challenges and test the strength of their partnership.
A determined man embarks on a high-stakes quest—and defies seemingly impossible odds—to fulfill his dream of being the first to reach the summit of Mount Everest.

A formidable intergalactic threat seeks to gather six powerful artifacts, putting the fate of Earth and the wider universe at risk. As heroes and allies unite to stop him, they face a challenge that tests the limits of their strength and resolve.

A science teacher wakes aboard a spacecraft light-years from home with no memory of how he got there. As his memories return, he learns that a mysterious substance is causing the sun to fade, and he must use his scientific knowledge and inventive thinking to find a way to protect Earth.

After a devastating conflict leaves a family facing loss, a new threat emerges on Pandora: a fierce Na’vi clan with its own ambitions. As the family fights to survive, old wounds and fresh tensions test their bonds and challenge the future of their world.

More than a decade after the first film, a family faces new dangers on Pandora and leaves its forest home in search of safety. As they adapt to life among ocean-dwelling people, they struggle to protect one another and survive the threats that follow them.

A group of mischievous little creatures make their way into Hollywood and become movie stars, only to lose their success and unleash monsters through their filmmaking antics. With chaos spreading, they must work together to try to undo the trouble and save the planet.

As a teenager enters a new stage of life, her mind’s familiar emotions face an unexpected change when Anxiety arrives alongside other new feelings. At hockey camp, she navigates shifting friendships and the pressure to fit in, while the emotions try to understand how to guide her through it all.

In his second year as a crime-fighter, a masked vigilante investigates a series of killings that expose corruption across Gotham City. As he follows the clues, he confronts secrets tied to his family and questions what justice should mean for the troubled city.

After a devastating defeat leaves the universe in ruins, a group of surviving heroes reunites with a bold plan to undo the damage and restore order. Their mission tests their resolve and draws on the bonds built through years of shared battles, with consequences that could change everything.

A professor is caught in a deadly outbreak when a rapidly changing virus spreads during a biotech conference and authorities seal the facility. Trapped inside with a small group of survivors, she must find a way to stay alive as the infected transform and the danger grows.

t: Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone
plot: An eleven-year-old boy who has spent his life with unkind relatives discovers he is a wizard and has a place at a school of magic. As he learns about this new world and makes friends, he begins to investigate a mystery connected to his family’s past.

Years after the events of the original animated series, the world’s last Airbender discovers an ancient power that could preserve his culture. Joined by friends, he travels across the world to find it before it reaches the wrong hands and endangers a fragile peace.
A strange doorway appears in the basement of a furniture showroom.

Two Brooklyn plumber brothers are transported through a mysterious pipe into a magical world, where they are separated. One brother sets off on a fast-moving quest to reunite with the other, encountering colorful new places and familiar challenges along the way.

After a shipwreck, an intelligent robot is stranded on an uninhabited island. As the robot learns to survive among wary animals, it forms an unexpected bond with an orphaned gosling and takes on the challenge of raising it in the wild.

When a dangerous threat puts the world at risk, an international peacekeeping agency brings together a team of extraordinary heroes. As powerful personalities clash and cooperation proves difficult, the newly formed group must learn to work together to protect humanity.

t: The Hobbit: The Battle of the Five Armies
plot: After a dragon’s attack devastates Laketown, a hobbit and a company of dwarves face competing claims to a mountain’s treasure from nearby men and elves. As a vast orc army approaches, former rivals must consider an uneasy alliance to defend the mountain and the wider realm from looming darkness.

As Earth becomes increasingly difficult to live on, a former pilot joins a group of explorers on a mission to seek a possible new home for humanity. Using a newly discovered wormhole to travel vast distances, the team faces an uncertain journey with the future of people on Earth at stake.

When an 11-year-old moves to a new city, her emotions try to help her adjust to a life away from familiar friends and routines. After two of them become lost in the reaches of her mind, they must find their way back while the others try to manage the upheaval.

t: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
plot: As armies gather for a decisive battle, the fate of Middle-earth hangs in the balance. A hobbit and his loyal companion undertake a perilous journey into Mordor to destroy a powerful ring, while their allies fight to distract the enemy and preserve their last hope.

In a 19th-century village, a nervous young man preparing for an arranged wedding accidentally makes a vow to a mysterious bride from the underworld. As he tries to return to the living world and the woman waiting for him, he encounters an unexpected new community and a tangled romantic predicament.

A celebrated archaeologist is recruited by the government to find the legendary Ark of the Covenant. As he searches for the ancient artifact, he faces a race against the Nazi regime, with danger and adventure at every turn.

A biology PhD candidate and a demanding professor enter a fake relationship to solve their romantic dilemmas. What begins as a carefully planned arrangement soon complicates their views on love, forcing both to navigate unexpected feelings and the pressures of academic life.

During World War II, a physicist leads a team of scientists in developing the atomic bomb. As their work reshapes the course of history, he faces the personal, political, and moral consequences of creating a weapon with immense power.

After his identity as Spider-Man is revealed, a young hero struggles to protect his private life and the people close to him. Seeking help from a sorcerer, he sets off events that bring new dangers and force him to consider what responsibility as a hero really means.

A retired racing veteran is drawn back into Formula 1 to help a struggling team and mentor its talented young driver. As their different styles collide, they must find a way to work together while pursuing a long-shot chance at success.

During World War II, a gifted mathematician joins a team of code-breakers at a secret British school, racing to decipher a code that could change the course of the conflict. As pressure mounts, his difficult working relationships and the challenges of fitting in shape the effort.

Thirty years after an earlier case, a new blade runner uncovers a long-hidden secret that could throw society into chaos. The discovery sends him on a search for a former blade runner who has been missing for decades, while raising questions about identity, memory, and what it means to be human.

After a ruthless enemy strikes close to home, a troubled young hero reluctantly joins an unlikely companion on a dangerous journey across the stars. Their quest for justice and revenge becomes a colorful, action-filled adventure involving powerful foes, unexpected allies, and a race to save someone important to them.

A quiet beekeeper launches a campaign for vengeance after a devastating scam brings tragedy to someone close to him. As he pursues those responsible, the case grows into a national crisis and draws the attention of a clandestine organization tied to his past.

An experienced Navy pilot who has avoided promotion is called back to train a group of elite young aviators for a dangerous, highly specialized mission. As the trainees face demanding challenges, their instructor must help them work together and prepare for a task few pilots have ever attempted.

A young nobleman joins forces with desert-dwelling rebels on a journey of revenge against those who destroyed his family. As he grows closer to a fierce warrior and embraces a possible leadership role, he must weigh personal love against the future of an entire universe.

After fleeing post-war Europe, an ambitious architect arrives in Pennsylvania hoping to rebuild his career and create a lasting legacy. When a wealthy patron offers him a major project, he and his wife face new challenges as they try to establish a life in America.

On death row in a Southern prison, a compassionate head guard encounters a gentle giant whose mysterious ability to heal changes life on the cell block. As the guard and his colleagues grow closer to the condemned inmate, they struggle with the weight of their duties and the possibility that his fate may be unjust.

After an emperor dies, a trusted Roman general is pushed aside as the emperor’s son takes power. Forced into slavery and made to fight as a gladiator for public entertainment, he faces a brutal new life in an empire shaped by ambition, loyalty, and the struggle for justice.

In a future ruled by machines, a cyborg assassin is sent back to 1984 to hunt a woman whose unborn child is destined to lead the human resistance. A soldier from that future follows, determined to protect her as the two face a relentless threat.

A teenager is accidentally sent from 1985 back to 1955, where he disrupts his parents’ first meeting and draws the attention of his future mother. With help from an eccentric inventor, he must set things right and find a way back to his own time.

A shepherd reads detective stories to his flock each night, never suspecting they understand. When a mysterious incident shakes up life on the farm, the sheep draw on what they have learned to investigate clues and human suspects, taking on an unusual case that tests their wits and their place in the human world.

After surviving a brutal tournament, a young woman is taken to a hidden district where a rebellion against the ruling Capitol is gathering strength. Asked to become its public symbol, she struggles with trauma, divided loyalties, and the danger facing someone she loves as propaganda and war reshape her world.

A supervillain sets out to prove himself by planning an audacious theft of the Moon. To advance his scheme, he adopts three orphaned girls, but the bond that grows between them begins to challenge the criminal life he has always known.

An animal-loving young woman uses a new technology that lets people enter lifelike robotic animals and experience the world from an animal’s perspective. As she explores the wildlife around her, she discovers a lively community and tries to protect its home from a proposed road project.

A talented young drummer at an elite music school is driven to pursue perfection under the direction of a ruthless instructor. As the pressure intensifies, his ambition pushes him toward increasingly costly choices and tests what he is willing to sacrifice for success.

t: Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban
plot: A young wizard returns to Hogwarts as a dangerous escaped prisoner threatens his safety. With frightening creatures nearby and new mysteries unfolding at school, he and his friends face growing fears while learning more about the past and the forces surrounding them.

t: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire
plot: When a young wizard is unexpectedly chosen to compete in a dangerous tournament between three schools, he faces daunting challenges and strained friendships. As he prepares with help from those close to him, unsettling signs point to a growing threat beyond the competition.

t: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets
plot: At the start of a second year at a school of magic, a young wizard is warned by a house-elf that danger is near. When mysterious writing appears on a wall and students are threatened, he and his friends investigate the legend of a hidden chamber and try to protect their school.

After a perilous mission goes wrong, a surviving agent learns that an insider may have compromised the intelligence agency and finds himself under suspicion. With his reputation and freedom at stake, he assembles a small team and pursues the truth through a tense world of espionage, theft, and shifting loyalties.

A man invites his closest friends to celebrate his 45th birthday at the lavish farm estate he shares with his wife in northern Sweden. When a ferocious storm traps everyone together, their polished manners give way to panic, tensions rise, and unexpected feelings emerge.

A New York City jeweler, always chasing the next big score, makes a string of high-stakes bets in hopes of a life-changing win. As pressure mounts from his business, family, and people he owes, he struggles to keep the pieces of his life from coming apart.

After a difficult period, a young woman joins her adventurous best friend on a climb up a remote, abandoned radio tower. When they become stranded high above the ground with no easy way down, the two must rely on their climbing skills and each other while facing the elements, dwindling supplies, and vertigo-inducing heights.

t: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu No Yaiba Infinity Castle
plot: Pulled into a vast, shifting fortress, a group of demon slayers are separated and forced into fierce battles against powerful demons. As they struggle to survive and protect one another, the fight marks the beginning of a larger confrontation, with moments of action and painful histories shaping the conflict.

A skilled thief who enters people’s subconscious to steal secrets is offered a chance to reclaim his former life. To do so, he must take on an unusually difficult assignment: planting an idea in someone’s mind through a dream.

After her father dies, a young woman is left under the control of her unkind stepmother and stepsisters. Though her life becomes difficult, she holds on to hope and kindness, and an unexpected meeting in the woods begins to change her circumstances.

A powerful Italian-American crime family navigates loyalty, influence, and conflict in postwar New York. After the family patriarch survives an attempt on his life, his youngest son steps in to protect the family, drawing him closer to a world he once hoped to avoid.

A gifted young heir is sent with his family to a harsh desert world prized for its rare and powerful resource. As rival forces struggle for control, he must face danger, adapt to an unfamiliar world, and consider the future awaiting his family and its people.

After her husband dies suddenly, a grieving widow turns to his family for support, only to face growing danger as they are overtaken by demonic forces. Trapped in an isolated family home, she must confront a terrifying ordeal shaped by fear, grief, and the bonds that endure.

After thwarting a previous scheme, two plumber brothers face a new threat from a young heir determined to free his imprisoned father and restore their family legacy. With familiar and new companions, they journey across the stars to stop his campaign, encountering a series of colorful interstellar adventures along the way.

A covert operations expert leads an expedition to an isolated island to collect genetic material from three enormous dinosaurs. When the mission crosses paths with a family stranded at sea, the group must face the island’s dangers and a startling discovery hidden for decades.

A fading celebrity, pushed aside as she grows older, turns to a black-market drug that can create a younger, enhanced version of herself. The offer promises a chance to reclaim attention, but balancing two versions of one life brings mounting pressure and conflict.

t: Pirates of the Caribbean: At World's End
plot: After a clever pirate is trapped in a supernatural realm, his allies race to bring him back before a powerful trading company takes control of the seas. Their journey draws pirate leaders together for a dangerous confrontation, where shifting alliances and competing loyalties put the future of piracy at stake.

Sentenced to life in prison for the murders of his wife and her lover, a reserved banker begins adapting to the harsh realities of Shawshank. He uses his accounting skills to assist prison authorities and gradually earns the respect of fellow inmates, forming a lasting friendship while holding on to hope.

A trio of K-pop superstars spend their days performing for devoted fans and their nights protecting them from supernatural threats. Balancing life in the spotlight with dangerous demon-hunting duties, they bring music and action together in a colorful fantasy adventure.

Years after witnessing the death of a revered Roman hero, a young man is forced into the Colosseum when his home is conquered by tyrannical emperors. Driven by anger and facing a Rome at a crossroads, he must draw on his past as he fights for honor and the future of the empire.

As a masked crime fighter and his allies work to dismantle Gotham’s criminal organizations, the city begins to see a fragile path toward justice. Their efforts are challenged by a dangerous criminal mastermind whose campaign of chaos tests the limits of their partnership and their beliefs.

A 19-year-old woman follows a familiar white rabbit and returns to a strange fantasy world from her childhood. As the land faces danger under an oppressive ruler, she must navigate unusual allies, confront expectations, and decide what kind of life she truly wants.

Decades after surviving the Titanic’s voyage, an elderly woman recounts her time aboard the ship. As a young passenger traveling with her mother and fiancé, she meets a lively third-class traveler, and their connection unfolds against the backdrop of the ship’s maiden voyage and its impending disaster.

After being kidnapped and released, a wealthy businessman's daughter is assigned a bodyguard by her concerned father. Their difficult relationship gradually shifts as attraction grows, while they navigate a dangerous world filled with uncertainty and hidden agendas.

A college student living with a chronic illness travels to Mallorca with her mother for the summer. There, she falls for a local and starts embracing the present, but worsening health and buried family secrets threaten the life and romance she has begun to build.

After reuniting with an old friend, a Brooklyn teen superhero is swept into a vast network of Spider-People from across the multiverse. When they disagree over how to face a growing threat, he must choose his own path while trying to protect the people he loves.

In 1920s Oklahoma, oil wealth transforms life for the Osage Nation, whose land holds valuable reserves. As Osage people are murdered and their wealth is threatened, a federal investigation begins to uncover the crimes and the forces behind them.

Twin brothers return to their Mississippi hometown hoping to make a fresh start by opening a juke joint. As the community gathers for a night of music, a sinister force emerges, bringing danger that challenges the brothers and those around them.

A secretive government task force sends a group of imprisoned supervillains to a remote island on a dangerous mission. As they face hostile forces, the unlikely team must find a way to work together amid chaos and danger.

A former supervillain turned devoted father is recruited by a secret organization to help track down a powerful new criminal. As he takes on the investigation, he balances the demands of the case with family life and an energetic new partner.

t: Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Man's Chest
plot: A roguish pirate faces a dangerous debt to a fearsome sea captain and searches for a way to escape eternal service aboard a ghostly ship. Two allies are pulled into the quest, each with their own troubles, as shifting loyalties and monstrous threats complicate their journey.

t: Ice Age: Dawn of the Dinosaurs
plot: As a mammoth and his partner prepare for a new arrival, their sloth friend finds dinosaur eggs and is drawn into a dangerous underground world. The rest of the herd sets off to help, encountering prehistoric creatures and an eccentric guide along the way, while a familiar acorn-obsessed squirrel pursues a new distraction.

A pair of hit men, a crime boss’s restless wife, and a boxer caught in the criminal underworld follow separate paths that sometimes cross. Their darkly comic adventures unfold across several connected stories, told out of chronological order, as everyday conversations and dangerous situations collide.

Two Mexican officers face a desperate fight to survive the final hours of their shift after crossing a ruthless cartel boss. Their night becomes a tense struggle against a dangerous threat, with their safety hanging in the balance.

From his early days as a remarkably gifted young performer in a family group, a future pop superstar pursues a solo career and an ambition to become the world’s biggest entertainer. The story follows his rise through music, family pressures, life away from the stage, and recreations of several memorable performances.

A desperate working-class father enters a deadly televised competition to afford medication for his sick daughter. Hunted across the country while millions watch, he relies on grit and quick thinking to survive a game designed to turn his struggle into mass entertainment.

As an angry mob turns against an outcast witch, she and her former friend must confront their differences and find a way to work together. Their bond is tested as they face the forces shaping Oz, with honesty and empathy at the heart of their struggle.

In a retro-futuristic world inspired by the 1960s, a close-knit team of heroes faces an immense threat to Earth. As they work to protect the planet, they must also navigate the demands of heroism and the importance of their family bond.

A young aspiring musician struggles against his family’s generations-old ban on music. After a mysterious turn of events takes him to the vibrant Land of the Dead, he teams up with a charming trickster on a journey to understand his family’s past and find a way home.

A mysterious object is discovered beneath the lunar surface, prompting a mission to uncover its origins. A crew travels into space with the help of an advanced onboard computer, as the journey raises questions about humanity, technology, and the unknown.

After years of daring missions, a close-knit crew faces a dangerous new threat driven by revenge and connected to their past. As the enemy targets everything they care about, they must rely on their skills and loyalty while the conflict unfolds across multiple locations.

Already established as a hero in Metropolis, a journalist with an extraordinary heritage faces the challenge of balancing his Kryptonian roots with the human upbringing that shaped him. As he tries to do good in a complicated world, questions of identity and what it means to be a hero come into focus.

A shy high school student gains extraordinary abilities after a genetically altered spider bites him. As he learns what it means to use his powers, he balances personal feelings, family responsibilities, and the demands of becoming a masked hero.

After a weapons maker is captured and held in an Afghan cave, he uses his engineering skills to build an armored suit and escape. Back home, the experience changes how he sees his company’s weapons, and he sets out to stop them from being used for harm.

t: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 2
plot: As the wizarding world faces its greatest danger, a young wizard and his two closest friends continue their quest to defeat a powerful enemy. Their journey leads back to a familiar school, where allies prepare for a sweeping battle and the young wizard discovers magical objects that may help him face his rival.

When a toy collector takes Woody, his friends set out on a daring rescue mission. Meanwhile, Woody meets new toys and learns more about his past, prompting him to consider where he belongs and what it means to be loved as a toy.

After years apart, a powerful sword guides a young prince back to a shattered Eternia, now under a fearsome ruler’s control. To protect his family and save his world, he must unite with trusted allies and accept the heroic destiny waiting within him.

A group of champions, joined by a reluctant new ally, must face off against one another in a brutal fight to stop a ruthless ruler whose ambitions threaten Earthrealm and its defenders. Their struggle brings together martial arts, fantasy, and high-stakes combat.

In the pre–Civil War South, a freed man teams up with a German bounty hunter who trains him to track dangerous fugitives. Their partnership leads him toward a Mississippi plantation, where he hopes to rescue his wife from slavery and a brutal owner.

A young aspiring writer moves from the Midwest to New York, hoping to build a career, and lands a job assisting the demanding editor of a major fashion magazine. As she tries to meet the editor’s exacting expectations, she enters a high-pressure world that challenges her priorities and sense of self.

On Cybertron, two miner robots and their companions uncover a hidden truth about their world and its leadership. Their journey challenges old beliefs, tests their friendship, and sets them on paths that will shape the future of their robot civilization.

After waking to find a suburban neighborhood beyond their woodland home, a group of forest animals meet a clever raccoon who needs help replacing a lost food supply. He persuades them to venture into the human world, where their efforts bring new challenges—and a lesson about what family means.

Fresh out on parole, a charismatic thief quickly assembles a team of specialists for an ambitious overnight robbery targeting more than $150 million from three Las Vegas casinos. As the crew prepares to pull off the high-stakes plan, he also risks his chance to reconnect with his ex-wife, who is now involved with the casino owner.

Hoping to move on from her past, a struggling woman takes a live-in housekeeping job with a wealthy family. The position seems like a fresh start, but unsettling behavior and growing tensions in the household turn her new life into a dangerous game of secrets and power.

After being taken from her home by a ruthless biker horde, a young woman is drawn into a brutal struggle between rival powers controlling the wasteland. As she endures years of hardship and danger, she quietly builds the skills and resolve needed to seek a way back home.

After a criminal network kidnaps his daughter and corrupt police refuse to help, a desperate father sets out to find her himself. A determined journalist whose wife has also vanished joins him, and together they pursue the people responsible through a dangerous underworld.

A handful of outsiders spot dangerous cracks in the financial system and dig through confusing jargon, shady incentives, and willful ignorance to understand what’s coming. As they piece together the truth, the story mixes dark humor with rising dread, showing how a looming collapse could be seen—and still allowed to happen.

A haunted family tries to rebuild their lives after a terrifying ordeal, but unsettling activity soon follows them. With help from paranormal investigators, they explore a mysterious connection reaching back to the father’s childhood and the spirit world, as past and present begin to overlap.

Two magicians become bitter rivals, each driven to create the most astonishing illusion and outdo the other. Their contest grows into a dangerous struggle marked by obsession, deceit, and jealousy, as both men risk more and more in pursuit of mastery and acclaim.

A beloved cowboy toy feels threatened when a flashy space-themed newcomer becomes the favorite in a child’s room. After the two are separated from their owner, their rivalry turns into an adventurous test of courage, loyalty, and friendship.

In a machine-dominated future, a computer hacker begins to suspect that reality is not what it seems. After joining a group of underground rebels, he becomes involved in their fight against the powerful computers that rule the world and uncovers a startling new perspective on human life.

An investigative reporter and his alien symbiote are struggling to share a life when a prison interview brings them into the orbit of a dangerous killer. As a new threat emerges, the uneasy partners must confront their differences and find a way to work together.

A Brooklyn teenager struggling to balance school, family, and his place in the world gains spider-like powers after a mysterious bite. When a powerful machine disrupts reality, he encounters other spider-powered heroes from different dimensions and must learn how to handle his abilities amid an unexpected adventure.

A quiet man trying to leave his mysterious past behind has built a simple new life. When he befriends a young woman controlled by violent gangsters, he steps in to protect her, using long-hidden skills to stand up for people with nowhere else to turn.

After Arkham Asylum is destroyed, dangerous inmates flood Gotham City. A determined vigilante races to contain the chaos, but relentless battles push him toward physical and mental exhaustion as he faces a calculating new enemy who is determined to break him.

t: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
plot: A young hobbit inherits a mysterious ring and must leave his peaceful home to keep it from a powerful enemy. Joined by a group of companions, he sets out on a dangerous journey to the one place where the ring can be destroyed, facing peril across a vast and unfamiliar world.
